Why the Starfish Eats With Its Stomach Inside Out #Shorts

comments.author: @barrondickson5266
comments.text: It has no arms lol, that's just his head
comments.replyText: Ha! You're actually onto something — a starfish doesn't have a separate head and body the way most animals do. Its nervous system is spread across all five arms, and each arm has its own eyespot. So in a way, the whole starfish IS kind of a head! Thanks for watching!
